an8.13:1.1: 13 aṭṭhahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājāniyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgantve saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
an8.13:1.3: idha bhikkhave rañño bhadro assājāniyo ubhato sujāto hoti
an8.13:1.5: yassaṃ disāyaṃ aññepi bhadrā assājāniyā jāyanti tassaṃ disāyaṃ jāto hoti
an8.13:1.9: jegucchī hoti uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā abhinisīdituṃ vā abhinipajjituṃ vā
an8.13:1.10: so rato hoti sukhasaṃvāso na ca aññe asse ubbejetā
an8.13:1.11: yāni kho panassa tāni sāṭheyyāni kūṭeyyāni jimheyyāni vaṅkeyyāni tāni yathābhūtaṃ sārathissa āvikattā hoti
an8.13:1.14: kāmaññe assā vahantu vā mā vā ahamettha vahissāmīti cittaṃ uppādeti
an8.13:1.16: thāmavā hoti yāva jīvitamaraṇapariyādānā thāmaṃ upadhaṃsetā
an8.13:1.17: imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahaṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājāniyo rājaraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
an8.13:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an8.13:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
an8.13:2.9: so rato hoti sukhasaṃvāso na aññe bhikkhū ubbejetā
an8.13:2.10: yāni kho panassa tāni sāṭheyyāni kūṭeyyāni jimheyyāni vaṅkeyyāni tāni yathābhūtaṃ āvikattā hoti satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu
an8.13:2.11: tesamassa satthā vā viññū vā sabrahmacārī abhinimmadanāya vāyamati
an8.13:2.13: kāmaññe bhikkhū sikkhantu vā mā vā ahamettha sikkhissāmīti cittaṃ uppādeti
an8.13:2.18: kāmaṃ taco ca nhāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ yantaṃ purisathāmena purisaviriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ na taṃ apāpuṇitvā viriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatīti
an8.13:2.19: imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
